cases.name: record_variables_filter_limit_and_explain

graphql.document: query Document($when: Unsigned!, $cursor: Unsigned!, $status: String!) { record(kind: "document", validAt: $when, knownAt: $cursor, where: [{field: "status", comparison: EQ, value: $status}], limit: 10, explain: CONTRACT) { id status } }

cases.rrflowql: FROM record:document AT VALID $when KNOWN $cursor WHERE status = $status PROJECT id, status LIMIT 10 EXPLAIN CONTRACT
